title: Fantastic.
text: Fantastic show with professionals both on and off the stage. A real luxury to let yourself be carried away by the music and the dancers. I will repeat.
author: MATRIBUSTE

title: Fantastic flamenco
text: Absolutely brilliant!!! Do not miss this if you are in Barcelona - it is the best entertainment in town!!!
author: Jilly313

title: Great Flamenco and musical experience
text:
Excellent show, including music, singing, flamenco dancing. The venue is intimate and the staff are welcoming.
I recommend highly as a show and for an entertaining musical and dance experience. The artists give a great performance and are very skilled.
The accompanying drink was also very good!
The venue is in a good location too if you want to combine when tapas and a drink afterwards.
author: Klara-lara
